problem:
Let $V={R}_{2}[t]$ be the vector space of all polynomials of degree at most $2$, equipped with the inner product

$$
⟨x(t),y(t)⟩=x(-1)y(-1)+x(0)y(0)+x(1)y(1).
$$

 Find $⟨x(t),y(t)⟩$, if

$$
x(t)=5-2t+{t}^{2},\,y(t)=t-1.
$$

feedback.problem:
Let $V={R}_{2}[t]$ be the vector space of all polynomials of degree at most $2$, equipped with the inner product 

$$
⟨x(t),y(t)⟩=x(1)y(1)+x(2)y(2)+x(-2)y(-2).
$$

 Find $⟨x(t),y(t)⟩$, if

$$
x(t)={t}^{2}-5,\,y(t)={t}^{2}-3t.
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Computing the inner product according to the definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨x(t),y(t)⟩ & =x(1)y(1)+x(2)y(2)+x(-2)y(-2) \\  & =(-4)\cdot (-2)+(-1)\cdot (-2)+(-1)\cdot 10 \\  & =8+2-10 \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
